Marissa --

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the attachments. I skimmed the diagram and the RBAC export; useful. A few clarifying items before we loop security/procurement:

1) Can you confirm Redwood's SOC 2 status and whether the scope includes the control for user provisioning (CC6/CC7 equivalent)? Procurement will need an up-to-date SOC 2 report or an AOC.
2) For SAML: do you support IDP-initiated login and SAML assertion encryption (we require encrypted NameID/Assertion for our environment)?
3) SCIM: do you support SCIM 2.0 with group push? Any rate limits we should be aware of?
4) RBAC: can you provide a screenshot of the Admin console showing role assignment for "org_admin" and the audit log entry format when roles change?

If you can point me to where those items live in the Drive (or drop the screenshots in-line), we can get procurement moving. Otherwise, a 30-min walkthrough would be great -- Wed 10/14 9am PT works for me.

Thanks,
Alex Green
Director, IT Security | Nova Therapeutics
alex.green@nova-thera.com | +1 (617) 555-0099

Alex --

Thanks for the questions. Quick answers below and I attached the screenshots you requested. If anything needs more detail, Aditya and Dev are on the call tomorrow and can dive deeper.

1) SOC 2: Redwood is SOC 2 Type II certified. I've attached our SOC 2 cover summary and provided a HubSpot link to the compliance pack (full report available under NDA/AOC).
   - Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-nova-iam-evidence (SOC 2 summary + AOC request form)
2) SAML: We support both IdP-initiated and SP-initiated flows. Assertion encryption is supported; see saml-config-sample.txt for metadata and example settings.
3) SCIM: We support SCIM 2.0, including group push. Typical rate limit is 500 requests/min by default; we can increase for enterprise customers on Dedicated/Private plans.
4) RBAC / Audit: Attached are two items: admin-role-screenshot.png (role assignment UI) and audit-log-sample.txt (sanitized sample of role-change event format).

Attachments: admin-role-screenshot.png, audit-log-sample.txt, soc2-cover-summary.pdf

We also included a short FAQ in the Drive folder about HIPAA/GDPR considerations and data residency options. If procurement needs a single zip for legal, say the word and we'll prepare it with AOC and our DPA.

Confirming the walkthrough: Wed 10/14 9:00 AM PT. Invite to follow.

Best,
Marissa
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
